subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram — full agent activity visibility (Web UI parity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off persistent Telegram activity mode, and what disclosure, redaction, retention, NO_REPLY/internal-turn, and message-volume policy should it use?
rationale: The requested gap is real on current main, but fixing it would add Telegram disclosure/retention behavior and likely config surface rather than repairing a narrow broken path.

options.title: Add guarded Telegram activity mode
options.body: Implement a default-off mode with redacted summaries, bounded message volume, internal-turn exclusions, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep current Telegram visibility model
options.body: Document progress previews plus /verbose and /reasoning as the intended Telegram debugging surfaces and close this after explicit maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Keep durable detail outside Telegram
options.body: Direct durable activity inspection to Control UI or a purpose-built plugin/channel surface rather than retaining detailed telemetry in Telegram chat history.

recommendation.title: Add guarded Telegram activity mode
recommendation.body: Implement a default-off mode with redacted summaries, bounded message volume, internal-turn exclusions, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal for a cross-cutting Telegram delivery, activity-observer UX, and security-defaults choice.
